title: 第461章 枭首枯剑第461章 枭首枯剑
slug: 北侯世子反派的我背景逆天
lines: 云辛杰的面孔早已剧烈地扭曲、痉挛，仿佛皮肉之下有无数条毒蛇在疯狂游走。
他的左半边脸，是年轻、惊恐且绝望的模样，右半边脸，则是雪无痕那老谋深算、冷酷无情的威严神态。
竟是硬生生缝合了两副截然不同的面孔！
以雪无痕可怖的真灵，配合上玄奥无比的夺玄术，在云辛杰这具身躯内当如入无人之境，轻易便可抹去他的神智。
然而下一刻，雪无痕却骤然发现了一丝的不对劲。
原本顺畅无比的夺舍进程，在这一瞬间犹如撞上了一堵不可逾越的铁壁！
云辛杰那即将溃散的真灵，在法诀的催动下，竟化作无数张长满獠牙的猩红巨口，非但没有被雪无痕吞噬，反而犹如疯狗一般，狠狠地反咬在雪无痕的黑色真灵之上。
“这是什么咒诀？！你这孽障，从哪里学来的这等邪术？！”
识海中，雪无痕发出了一声惊怒咆哮。
他骇然发现，自己那玄奥的夺玄术，竟然被这股莫名其妙的逆乱之力死死克制。
两人的真灵，在这具狭小的肉躯内，彻底陷入了最原始、最残酷的疯狂纠缠。
肉身上的异样变得愈发骇人听闻。
枯剑老人脸上本来带着已经胜利的笑意，然而随着时间的流逝，那张浑浊的眼睛缓缓地瞪大，眼底满是无法掩饰的震惊与骇然。
“这……这怎么可能？”
按照阁主的推算，夺舍云辛杰不过是手到擒来之事，最多半炷香的时间便可大功告成。
可现在，阁主的真灵竟然陷入了泥沼之中，不仅没能瞬间抹杀云辛杰，反而被对方死死地拖在了识海的深渊里。
枯剑老人又惊又怒。
目光中——
云辛杰的躯体时而膨胀如球，皮肤寸寸开裂，渗出粘稠的黑血，时而又干瘪如柴，骨骼发出令人牙酸的摩擦声。
那两副半张的面孔在疯狂地交替、重叠，两股水火不容的真灵在经脉中横冲直撞，面孔无比的痛苦嘶吼，仿佛带来的是足以让人意志崩溃的凌迟之痛。
就在枯剑老人惊疑不定之时。
那具剧烈痉挛的身躯猛地抬起头，脸庞在刹那间威严起来。那张嘴极其艰难地张开，发出急促且愤怒的吼声：
“枯剑！还愣着干什么？！快来帮我！这家伙的识海里有古怪，他懂得专门克制夺玄术的逆乱法门！快分出你的真灵，帮我镇压他的本源！”
听到阁主的求救，枯剑老人心头大震。
他深知此刻已是生死存亡的紧要关头，若阁主夺舍失败，必定遭到夺舍反噬，甚至形神俱灭也不是没有可能。
“属下遵命！”
枯剑老人猛地一咬牙，盘膝坐下，双手结出一个法印，口中念念有词。
下一刻，他眉心处裂开一道缝隙，一股灰色真灵，直接刺入了云辛杰的眉心之中。
随着枯剑老人的真灵入局，识海内的平衡瞬间被打破。
原本凭借“逆乱噬魂诀”勉强与父亲抗衡的云辛杰，顿时感觉到一股犹如泰山压顶般的恐怖压力从天而降。
云辛杰的真灵在识海中发出绝望的哀鸣。
他能清晰地感觉到，自己的灵魂防线正在被寸寸瓦解，记忆正在被剥离，他那刚刚升起的一丝希望，在坠入了万劫不复的深渊。
“乖乖化作灰烬吧！”雪无痕残忍的笑声占据了整个脑海。

Yun Xinjie's face had already been violently twisted and convulsed, as if there were countless poisonous snakes swimming crazily under his skin.
The left half of his face showed a young, frightened and desperate look, while the right half of his face showed Xue Wuhen's scheming, ruthless and majestic look.
It turned out that two completely different faces were stitched together!
With Xue Wuhen's terrifying true spirit, coupled with the incomparably mysterious Seizing Technique, Yun Xinjie's body felt like he was in an uninhabited land, and his mind could be wiped out easily.
However, the next moment, Xue Wuhen suddenly noticed something was wrong.
The originally smooth process of seizing the body was like hitting an insurmountable iron wall at this moment!
Yun Xinjie's true spirit, which was about to collapse, turned into countless huge scarlet mouths covered with fangs under the stimulation of the magic formula. Instead of being swallowed by Xue Wuhen, it bit back on Xue Wuhen's black true spirit like a mad dog.
"What kind of spell is this?! Where did you learn such evil magic?!"
In the sea of consciousness, Xue Wuhen let out an angry roar.
He was shocked to find that his mysterious Mystic Seizing Technique was restrained by this inexplicable force of rebellion.
The true spirits of the two people were completely entangled in the most primitive and cruel madness in this small body.
The strangeness in his body became more and more horrifying.
...
The old man Kujian originally had a victorious smile on his face, but as time passed, his cloudy eyes slowly widened, filled with shock and horror that could not be concealed.
"This...how is this possible?"
According to the calculations of the pavilion master, seizing Yun Xinjie's body is just a matter of hand, and it can be accomplished in half a stick of incense at most.
But now, the pavilion master's true spirit was trapped in the quagmire. Not only was he unable to kill Yun Xinjie instantly, but he was dragged tightly into the abyss of the sea of ​​consciousness.
Old Man Kujian was shocked and angry.
In the eyes——
Sometimes Yun Xinjie's body swells like a ball, with his skin cracked and oozing thick black blood, and sometimes it dries up like firewood, and his bones make a tooth-piercing friction sound.
The two half-faces were alternating and overlapping crazily, and the two incompatible true spirits were rushing through the meridians. The faces screamed in incomparable pain, as if they were bringing about Lingchi pain that was enough to break one's will.
Just when Old Man Kujian was in doubt.
The violently convulsing body suddenly raised its head, and its face became majestic in an instant. The mouth opened with great difficulty and let out a rapid and angry roar:
"Withered Sword! Why are you still standing there?! Come and help me! There is something weird in this guy's sea of consciousness. He knows the secret method of counteracting chaos by seizing the mystic arts! Separate your true spirit quickly and help me suppress his origin!"
Hearing the pavilion master's plea for help, Old Man Kujian was shocked.
He knew that this moment was a critical moment of life and death. If the master of the pavilion failed to seize the body, he would definitely be counterattacked by the seizure, and it was not impossible that he would even be destroyed physically and mentally.
"I obey my orders!"
The old man Ku Jian gritted his teeth suddenly, sat down cross-legged, formed a seal with his hands, and muttered something in his mouth.
The next moment, a gap opened between his eyebrows, and a gray true spirit pierced directly into Yun Xinjie's eyebrows.
As the true spirit of Old Man Kujian entered the situation, the balance in the sea of ​​consciousness was instantly broken.
Yun Xinjie, who had been barely able to compete with his father with the "Soul Devouring Art of Reverse Chaos", suddenly felt a terrifying pressure descending from the sky, like a mountain of mountains.
"No...don't..."
Yun Xinjie's true spirit let out a desperate cry in the sea of consciousness.
He could clearly feel that his soul's defense line was being disintegrated inch by inch, his memory was being stripped away, and his newly raised glimmer of hope was falling into an abyss of eternal destruction.
"Turn into ashes obediently!" Xue Wuhen's cruel laughter occupied his entire mind.
